source_scope: Bounded digest of the three initial owner decisions and later same-day financing, completed-cohort, capacity and interactive-scenario clarifications. Exact private conversation retained separately. These are POL intentions and functional requirements, not empirical results.

completed_cohort_subsidy_exit.completion_semantics: Verified completion of all three named components; enrolment or work underway is insufficient.
completed_cohort_subsidy_exit.policy_effect: Completed qualifying household leaves the replaced energy-subsidy channel. Attribute only support actually replaced by that household or cohort.
completed_cohort_subsidy_exit.comparison_source_and_calendar: Explicit qualified baseline, prices, service, billing periods and subsidy rule required; missing evidence is not a pass.

fiscal_reinvestment_mechanism.recurrence: Each completed qualifying cohort can release avoided state subsidy again in each subsequent applicable period; later cohorts add their own attributable release.
fiscal_reinvestment_mechanism.release_basis: Actual attributable counterfactual state-subsidy cash avoided, net of separately assigned public costs and obligations, at available cash dates.
fiscal_reinvestment_mechanism.funding_feedback: Available released cash retained for the programme can fund subsequent cohorts; household savings are a separate ledger.
fiscal_reinvestment_mechanism.seed_financing: Initial investment, training and timing bridges require separately evidenced funding; future savings are not cash already available.
fiscal_reinvestment_mechanism.reinvestment_share: Explicit time-varying0..1 parameter; no canonical numeric share selected.
fiscal_reinvestment_mechanism.withdrawal_case: At0 all released cash is withdrawn by the state. Household physical/bill benefits may remain; rollout depends on other sources and constraints.
fiscal_reinvestment_mechanism.growth: Acceleration is a possible endogenous outcome, bounded by finance, workforce, equipment and network constraints; no fixed growth rate selected.

delivery_capacity_and_formality.training: Upfront vocational capacity for heat-pump installation, insulation and electrical work is a programme option/requirement to size with rollout.
delivery_capacity_and_formality.training_lags_and_costs: Explicit inputs; no instant conversion of training spend to qualified installer output.

horizon_discussion.meaning: Discussed approximate10–20year project range; no single horizon or uniform distribution selected.

interactive_scenarios.scope: Eventual model interface with explicit parameter changes around one checked canonical baseline. No immediate website build or giant uncertainty Cartesian grid.
interactive_scenarios.infeasible_combination: Show missing evidence, financing shortfall or violated constraints explicitly; do not force a feasible result.

decisions.cost_scope: Building size, type, heat loss, condition and required work scope affect sizing and cost; use existing typology evidence, no single uniform package price.
decisions.envelope_package_scope: Condition-appropriate window/door replacement is included in the building-specific envelope assessment and required works. Already adequate openings are not automatically replaced. Combined envelope/heat-pump effects must not double count savings.

scenario_creation: Explicit target, horizon, profile and all required evidence still required; no fallback to historical 15-year default or 2M exact target.

illustrative_or_unverified_numbers.900bn_then100bn_annual_reduction: Illustration only; not forecast, target or input.
illustrative_or_unverified_numbers.500k_annual_bill_and250k_saving: Illustration only; not measured household mean.
illustrative_or_unverified_numbers.1000bn_annual_subsidy: Order-of-magnitude claim under separate official source check; never fully programme-reinvestable by default.
illustrative_or_unverified_numbers.SPF3_or_one_third_energy: Conditional physical illustration; not an observed WM50 annual result or a bill ratio.
illustrative_or_unverified_numbers.near_zero_operating_cost: Insulation intuition must not zero electricity, maintenance, batteries or heat-pump replacements.
illustrative_or_unverified_numbers.energy_price_growth: No monotonic future price path selected.
illustrative_or_unverified_numbers.20_to_25million_HUF_package: Explicitly clarified by owner as illustration only; not an estimate, model assumption or SCN parameter.
